analogy.name: A clinical drug trial
analogy.line: Patients are randomly split into the drug group and the placebo group, the length of the trial is fixed in advance, and nobody stops early because one week looked good.

analogy.name: Practice papers vs the real exam
analogy.line: Train on practice papers, tune on mock exams (validation), and open the real exam paper (test set) once. Peeking at it early means your score lies.

analogy.name: An open-book exam
analogy.line: The model answers better when you hand it the right pages first. RAG is finding those pages (retrieve) and putting them in front of it (prompt).
